# Online-capable folders preserve the saved Search online checkbox value

The dialog restores onlineSearch from the virtual-folder wrapper before checking selected server support. The updated guard clears the checkbox only when no selected server has truthy offline support; otherwise it preserves the loaded value. Accepting writes the property back through the wrapper. The new test directly checks enabled/checked across accept and reopen for an IMAP-backed virtual folder created with true. It does not directly cover false, offline-only transitions or an actual server search.

Scope: Virtual folder properties saved-state guard and regression test.
